metadata.description: Four-block validation (effect-size standardization, data-provenance reconciliation, cross-checks/literature recovery, methodological transparency audit) of the iter-1 survival-hazard reframing of UD dependency-arc lengths.

block1_effect_size_standardization.interpretation: The register effect of 0.046 (HR=1.047) corresponds to a 0.082-token reduction in median arc length at the pooled corpus median (1.85 tokens), placing it at the 25.0th percentile of the cross-language distribution of {written vs spoken} log-mean-arc-length contrasts (n=4 languages with both registers pooled from CoNLL-U-metadata/name-heuristic register labels).

iter1_vs_gold_subset.note: Gold subset is only 3 languages (n arcs << 300k full-corpus Cox subsample), so this tests DIRECTIONAL/magnitude consistency under a genuine label-quality restriction, not the plan's originally-envisioned iter1-vs-iter2 identical-pipeline check (no separate iter2 experiment artifact exists to diff against).

gold_label_source_documentation.citation: MacWhinney CHILDES corpus (child-directed/child speech transcripts, gold spoken-modality annotation) vs EWT (English Web Treebank, UD gold written)
gold_label_source_documentation.validated_against_metadata: register classified via classify_register(): CoNLL-U comment modality/channel tags where present, else curated name-based fallback matching the treebank's known genuine gold spoken-corpus status (not majority-written default).

gold_label_source_documentation.citation: Rhapsodie (Lacheret et al., gold prosody/spoken corpus) vs GSD (UD gold written)
gold_label_source_documentation.validated_against_metadata: register classified via classify_register(): CoNLL-U comment modality/channel tags where present, else curated name-based fallback matching the treebank's known genuine gold spoken-corpus status (not majority-written default).

gold_label_source_documentation.citation: SST (Slovenian Spoken/Spontaneous Treebank, gold transcribed speech) vs SSJ (UD gold written)
gold_label_source_documentation.validated_against_metadata: register classified via classify_register(): CoNLL-U comment modality/channel tags where present, else curated name-based fallback matching the treebank's known genuine gold spoken-corpus status (not majority-written default).

word_order_operationalization_comparison.description: Only ONE word-order operationalization is implemented in the iter-1 pipeline: empirical fraction of dependents preceding their head, computed directly per treebank from parsed head-position data (word_order_score). No second (e.g. WALS-fetched dominant-order class) operationalization was implemented, so no comparability/CI-overlap check across operationalizations is possible -- this is reported here as an honest audit finding, not fabricated.
word_order_operationalization_comparison.recommendation: A future iteration should add a second, independently-sourced word-order measure (e.g. WALS 81A dominant order) fitted on the identical 300k-arc subsample to test operationalization robustness.

bootstrap_procedure_specification.iter1_note: family_residual_hazard_ranking in the iter-1 output has no CI fields -- no bootstrap was run for the family outlier ranking in iter1. This evaluation adds one (below).
bootstrap_procedure_specification.sampling: with replacement, resampling treebanks within each family (block bootstrap over treebanks, not individual arcs, to respect within-treebank arc correlation)
